TARS Explorer 1.4.4 - source notes
==================================
Checked 2026-09-27.

Elite Dangerous Journal documentation:
- Exploration events: Scan, FSSAllBodiesFound, FSSBodySignals, FSSDiscoveryScan,
  SAAScanComplete, SAASignalsFound, CodexEntry
  https://elite-journal.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Exploration.html
- Odyssey ScanOrganic event:
  https://elite-journal.readthedocs.io/en/latest/New%20in%20Odyssey.html

BioInsights documentation:
- https://github.com/Xjph/observatory-docs/blob/main/pages/usage/plugins/thirdparty/bioinsights.mdx
- BioInsights predicts biologicals from body/star characteristics, narrows genus after
  DSS and species/variant after scanning.

BioInsights/COVAS integration status:
- Observatory Core issue #243 requests exposing BioInsights output for COVAS Next / EDCoPilot.
  This is why Explorer 1.0.0 does not pretend a supported direct BioInsights bridge exists.
  https://github.com/Xjph/ObservatoryCore/issues/243

BioInsights-related public data:
- https://github.com/matt-g-dev/bioinsights-data
- Repository is MIT licensed and described as data relevant to BioInsights.

Implementation note:
TARS Explorer 1.0.0 contains original journal-state and analysis code. It does not copy
prediction code from BioInsights, EDMC-BioScan or other third-party projects.
